summary_1line: Chyavana creates the colossal demon Mada to threaten Indra, forcing him to grant the Ashvins Soma rights before the demon is dispersed into worldly vices.

image_candidates.scene_text: The gigantic demon Mada towers with one jaw on earth and the other in heaven as Indra stares in terror with his paralyzed arm.
Sage Chyavana stands by the sacrificial fire chanting hymns as the monstrous being Mada forms from his ascetic power.
The immense demon rushes toward Indra with gaping mouth and lightning-like tongue while the world echoes with its roar.
